    Profile

    Malta is a shrine maiden excelling in spiritbonding, and is the daughter of Iakov, the village chief of Sephira. She was summoned through the power of Ouroboros. She takes pride in the responsibilities of a shrine maiden, even to the point of sacrificing herself for the greater good.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 159cm
    Weight: 46kg
    Birthday: Mar 15
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Things from outside her hometown, stories
    Hobbies: Dreaming
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 相坂優歌
